description: Puts one excluded person back into a campaign's audience, as Include anyway on its roster does: the exclusion is retracted and a running campaign drafts their next message again. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: include_campaign_recipients
title: Include a person in a campaign again
